Title: Diagnosis
Details: The test `testPcts` in the `FrequencyTest` class is failing due to a discrepancy in the implementation of the `getPct(Object)` method in the `Frequency` class. This discrepancy leads to the percentage calculation being cumulative instead of individual values, causing the test to fail. To fix this issue, the calls to `getPct(Object)` should be updated to `getPct(Comparable)` throughout the codebase.
